body:
## Scope

Current corrected English digital core game plus **Lure of the Valley**. First-print box code `LFCACD30` and later expansions are comparison/excluded except where a mixed public rule row also governs the target.

Supersedes blocked intake PR #21: https://github.com/no-trbl-2-u/game-knowledge-base/pull/21

Latest exact-head audit: https://github.com/no-trbl-2-u/game-knowledge-base/pull/21#issuecomment-5147511413

Legacy packet head: `acb4825d2f3d996dc3375f380b1554dd3b57171c`. **Do not merge that blocked packet.**

## Established evidence

- 96/96 Lure guide items acquired.
- 148 unique glossary leaves acquired.
- 33/33 FAQ Q&As acquired.
- 16/16 card-update pages acquired: 14 target and 2 Legacy-only.
- Printable errata PDF acquired and deduplicated.
- Physical gameplay-card arithmetic remains 540, but 540 is not a distinct-card identity or rules-text denominator.
- Four meaningful source-linked visual locators exist.
- Distinct factual and total governing coverage remain UNKNOWN/unscored.

## Required correction to the legacy packet

The latest audit found the glossary disposition to be:

- 119 core/Lure
- 4 target/later mixed
- 6 Legacy-only
- 5 Stewards-only
- 4 Moments-only
- 4 other-Valley-only
- 1 later-product index
- 5 cross-later-only

Therefore:

- target-applicable glossary rows: **123**
- excluded glossary rows: **25**
- bounded public target ledger: `1 rulebook + 96 Lure + 123 glossary + 32 FAQ + 14 card updates = 266`

The legacy packet’s `131` and `274` assertions must not be reused.

## Remaining blocker

- [ ] Acquire or obtain authorized inspection of an authoritative complete current corrected English core-plus-Lure distinct-card identity and rules-text inventory.
- [ ] Establish a defensible closed governing denominator without treating duplicate physical copies as distinct identities.
- [ ] Keep `rules.known_total` and `rules.percent` null until that denominator is authoritative.
- [ ] Revalidate product applicability against official expansion relationships.

## Completion criteria

Do not open another blocked-report PR. When the authority gap is closed:

1. create a fresh one-game intake run from current `main`;
2. stage a complete `ready_for_audit` packet with the corrected 266-row public ledger;
3. run every intake, provenance, and visual gate;
4. open exactly one Earthborne Rangers PR;
5. require independent exact-head audit before promotion.
